arabic text: TERA MATAM SHAHEDI BAPA HAI CHAND TARO ME
english translation text: O Martyr, your mourning has spread among the moon and stars.

arabic text: TERA AKBER SINE PE JISKE (MARA THA NEZA EHLE\nJAFA NE)\nROI KARABAL KI ZAMI BUKA THI REGZARO ME.
english translation text: Your Akbar—whose chest the people of cruelty pierced\nwith a spear—made the earth of Karbala\nweep, while lamentation rose through the desert.

arabic text: TERA KASSIM GHORO NE JISKO (PAMAL MAKAL ME\nKARDIYA THA)\nHAYE WO TANHA THA SARE MAKTAL HAZARO ME
english translation text: Your Qasim—whom the horses trampled\nin the battlefield—lay alone among\nthousands across the killing ground.

arabic text: TERA GHAZI DARYA KINARE (SOTA HAI HAYE SHANE\nKATAYE)\nROTA HAI DARYA FALAK HAI SOGWARO ME
english translation text: Your Ghazi sleeps beside the river with\nboth shoulders severed. The river weeps and\nthe heavens stand among the mourners.

arabic text: TERA ASGAR HATHOPE TERE (MARA GAYA JAB TIRE\nSITAMSE)\nCHAYI MAKTAL ME KHIZA FUGHA THI YE BAHARO ME
english translation text: Your Asghar was killed upon your hands by\nthe arrow of oppression. Autumn descended over\nthe battlefield, and even spring cried out.

arabic text: TERE GHAR KO UMMET NE LUTA (KAYME JALAYE\nCHINI RIDAYE)\nDETITHI ZEHRA DILASE DIL FIGARO ME
english translation text: The nation plundered your home, burned the\ntents and snatched the veils. Zahra\noffered comfort to every broken heart.

arabic text: TERI DHUKHTER DAGHE YATIMI (PAYA THA JISNE IS\nKAMSINIME)\nAGH DAMAN ME LAGI LAHU THA GOSHWARO ME
english translation text: Your daughter received the wound of orphanhood\nin her tender childhood. Fire caught her\nhem and blood stained her earrings.

arabic text: TERI BHENE JAB SAR BAREHNA (BAZARE KUFA SE\nJARITHI)\nROTETHE AGE FUGHA THI ASHK BARO ME
english translation text: When your sisters, bareheaded, were taken through the\nmarketplace of Kufa, the mourners ahead of\nthem wept and raised cries of grief.
